description: Design how an instant replay save turns the current rolling segments into a final MP4. Goals: zero re-encode when codec/profile/level/timebase are compatible across segments, exact requested duration trim at the leading edge, audio sidecar muxed correctly (carry forward the v1.1.0 audio sidecar stability fix), accurate fps/cadence even when capture jitters (carry forward the v1.1.0 replay FPS/cadence detection work), no fake duplicated-frame output. Define behavior when codec is inconsistent across segments (forced single-pass libx264 finalize, mirroring the v1.1.0 replay finalization safety net). Specify the export state machine so the UI cannot enter the v1.1.x freeze-during-save state again. Output: pipeline doc + state diagram. No code.
title: Design instant replay export/remux pipeline
